_comment: The one list of templates. Read by clipper/graphics.py (to list, check and stage props) and by src/Root.tsx (studio defaults). A template added here must also be registered in src/templates/index.ts. frame='card' renders onto overlay entries (sits over the speaker); frame='full' renders onto footage entries (replaces the picture).

LowerThird.description: Name + role for someone mentioned or speaking. The standard way to establish who a person is.

props.name: Person's name, as it should read on screen.
props.role: One line: title and organisation, e.g. 'Co-founder & CEO, Spade'.
props.position: Where it sits: 'bottom' stands just above the captions — over the chest in OTG framing, the least face it can cover; 'top' hangs just under the logo/sponsor zone (the top 20% is reserved); 'center' sits mid-frame, which in a tight shot is the face. Default 'bottom'.

Headline.description: A news card: where the story is from, the headline, and when. For establishing a story the audio refers to as already known.

props.headline: The headline itself. Keep it under ~90 characters; it is read, not skimmed.
props.date: Optional. When it happened, e.g. '3 Sept 2026'.
props.logo: Optional. Absolute path to a logo image (png/svg/jpg) shown beside the source.
props.position: Where it sits: 'bottom' stands just above the captions — over the chest in OTG framing, the least face it can cover; 'top' hangs just under the logo/sponsor zone (the top 20% is reserved); 'center' sits mid-frame, which in a tight shot is the face. Default 'bottom'.

example.headline: Revolut wins conditional US national bank charter

Stat.description: One number that matters, counting up to its value, with what it measures. For a figure the speaker says that has no scale on its own.

props.decimals: Optional. Decimal places to show. Default 0.
props.label: What the number is, one line: 'of US card payments'.
props.sublabel: Optional. Source or qualifier in small type.
props.position: Where it sits: 'bottom' stands just above the captions — over the chest in OTG framing, the least face it can cover; 'top' hangs just under the logo/sponsor zone (the top 20% is reserved); 'center' sits mid-frame, which in a tight shot is the face. Default 'bottom'.

Explainer.description: A short context card: a title and up to three lines, revealed one by one. For 'what is X' when a thing is named but never explained.

props.title: The question or thing being explained: 'What is X Money?'.
props.lines: 1-3 short strings, each one fact. Longer lines shrink the type.
props.position: Where it sits: 'bottom' stands just above the captions — over the chest in OTG framing, the least face it can cover; 'top' hangs just under the logo/sponsor zone (the top 20% is reserved); 'center' sits mid-frame, which in a tight shot is the face. Default 'bottom'.

example.title: What is X Money?
lines: Since 2 Sept, US creator payouts land here

ImageCard.description: A screenshot or image in a framed card with a slow push-in: an article, a tweet, a chart, a product. The image carries the content; the caption is optional.

props.caption: Optional. One line under the image.
props.credit: Optional. Small source credit, e.g. 'via Bloomberg'.
props.position: Where it sits: 'bottom' stands just above the captions — over the chest in OTG framing, the least face it can cover; 'top' hangs just under the logo/sponsor zone (the top 20% is reserved); 'center' sits mid-frame, which in a tight shot is the face. Default 'center'.

Bars.description: A horizontal bar chart that grows in. For comparing 2-5 values the speaker lists — market shares, fees, valuations.

props.title: Optional. What is being compared.
props.items: 2-5 of {label, value, highlight?}. value is a number; highlight=true draws that bar in the accent colour.
props.position: Where it sits: 'bottom' stands just above the captions — over the chest in OTG framing, the least face it can cover; 'top' hangs just under the logo/sponsor zone (the top 20% is reserved); 'center' sits mid-frame, which in a tight shot is the face. Default 'bottom'.

Breakdown.description: Full screen. A numbered list of 2-6 points revealed one by one. For conditions, reasons, steps — anything the speaker enumerates that a viewer would lose track of by ear.

props.kicker: Optional. Short label above the title, e.g. 'THE CONDITIONS', 'TIMELINE'.
props.title: Optional but usually wanted. What this frame is about, one line.
props.source: Optional. Small source line at the bottom, e.g. 'Source: OCC filing'.
props.points: 2-6 short strings, one idea each. Under ~60 characters reads well.

example.title: What the OCC demanded
points: Hold far more capital than a normal bank
No new products for 3 years without approval
A US-based board and management team

Timeline.description: Full screen. 2-6 dated events on a line that draws down. For how something unfolded — a sequence the audio compresses into one sentence.

props.kicker: Optional. Short label above the title, e.g. 'THE CONDITIONS', 'TIMELINE'.
props.title: Optional but usually wanted. What this frame is about, one line.
props.source: Optional. Small source line at the bottom, e.g. 'Source: OCC filing'.
props.events: 2-6 of {date, text}. date is short ('Mar 2024'); text one line.

example.title: Revolut's road to a US charter

Compare.description: Full screen. Two columns side by side with up to 5 points each, plus an optional one-line verdict. For A vs B — two products, two banks, before vs after.

props.kicker: Optional. Short label above the title, e.g. 'THE CONDITIONS', 'TIMELINE'.
props.title: Optional but usually wanted. What this frame is about, one line.
props.source: Optional. Small source line at the bottom, e.g. 'Source: OCC filing'.
props.left: {name, points: [..]} — the first side. Points short: the column is half the frame.
props.right: {name, points: [..]} — the second side, drawn in the accent colour.
props.verdict: Optional. One line under both columns: the takeaway.

example.title: Payouts: before vs after
example.verdict: X keeps the money in its own wallet.

Chart.description: Full screen. Horizontal bars for 2-8 values, growing in. For a comparison with more items or more weight than the Bars card can carry.

props.kicker: Optional. Short label above the title, e.g. 'THE CONDITIONS', 'TIMELINE'.
props.title: Optional but usually wanted. What this frame is about, one line.
props.source: Optional. Small source line at the bottom, e.g. 'Source: OCC filing'.
props.items: 2-8 of {label, value, highlight?}. value is a number; highlight=true draws it in the accent colour.

Quote.description: Full screen. A quotation with attribution. For something someone else said or wrote — a regulator, a CEO, an official statement — that the speaker is reacting to.

props.kicker: Optional. Short label above the title, e.g. 'THE CONDITIONS', 'TIMELINE'.
props.title: Optional but usually wanted. What this frame is about, one line.
props.source: Optional. Small source line at the bottom, e.g. 'Source: OCC filing'.
props.quote: The quotation, without quote marks. Under ~200 characters.
props.author: Who said it.
props.role: Optional. Their title or where it was said.

example.quote: We will not allow AI agents to transact without a human in the loop.
example.author: Jane Doe

Scroll.description: Full screen. A tall screenshot — an article, a filing, a thread — scrolling top to bottom through a window. For showing the real document the speaker is talking about.

props.kicker: Optional. Short label above the title, e.g. 'THE CONDITIONS', 'TIMELINE'.
props.title: Optional but usually wanted. What this frame is about, one line.
props.source: Optional. Small source line at the bottom, e.g. 'Source: OCC filing'.
props.image: Absolute path to a tall image (png/jpg/webp). Crop it to the part worth reading; the whole height scrolls past.

Hook.description: The clip's opening title: the hook line a scrolling viewer reads in the first 2-3 seconds. Big type, no card, words landing one by one; the phrase that carries the tension goes in *asterisks* and lands last on a yellow highlighter. One per clip, always at the start — set with set_clip_hook, not add_broll.

props.text: The hook, 7 words or fewer. Lead with the number or the tension. Mark one phrase with *asterisks* to highlight it.
props.kicker: Optional. Small label above, e.g. the show or topic. Leave empty by default.
props.position: Default 'top' — just under the logo/sponsor zone, the title slot.

example.text: Meta wants your inbox *and your card*
